initiative: U1 source and canonical identity core

types.source: SourceIdentity(system: SourceSystem, entityType: SourceEntityType, originalId: String)

mappingProposal.idPolicy: Retain original ID exactly, without normalization.
Retain original ID exactly; not a PERSON or ACCOUNT ID.

mappingProposal.sourceStorage: admin_users.id trusted UUID value rendered with UUID.toString() before this core
mappingProposal.idPolicy: Retain provided DB-derived ID; no UUID parsing/guessing in resolver.
Retain customer domain identity separately from pharmacist/account/person.

mappingProposal.sourceStorage: trusted original CRM branch ID plus separately verified crosswalk; physical crosswalk storage remains RFC-owned
mappingProposal.idPolicy: Only an explicit verified branch-to-existing-pharmacy binding. Enforce one-to-one in both directions; duplicate identical pair is idempotent.
No match by string/name/address/phone, no generated canonical ID. Preserve original branch and its ACL/history.
No automatic human merge or cross-domain binding. Existing account/role/ACL/history is not discarded because canonical person is unresolved.
Opaque format or similarity to an existing account/pharmacist ID never creates a person or account association.

invariants: Namespace consists of source system, source entity type and opaque original ID.
Case, leading zeros and whitespace inside a nonblank ID are preserved. No trim, case folding, numeric coercion, UUID-format inference or heuristic matching.
Canonical type is part of equality; account/person/pharmacist/customer remain distinct even when ID text is identical.
Blank source/canonical IDs and blank provenance references are rejected.
Unsupported relationship is rejected at binding construction, including all human/account/person bindings.
Forward mapping conflict and reverse alias conflict raise IllegalArgumentException; no source rows are deleted or silently merged.
Resolver snapshots input and does not observe later list mutation.
No database existence, identity verification, permission grant, SMS/HMAC proof or row migration is performed.

u2Agreement.rule: U2 does not derive person from account/pharmacist/customer. Missing proven PERSON identity keeps independent-review decisions fail-closed.
u2Agreement.boundary: PERSON value can be explicitly supplied by later verified U4 work, but this resolver never generates or derives one.

verificationReferenceBoundary: Provenance text only. Nonblank reference and a VerifiedCrosswalkBinding value are not proof that source endpoints, approval or evidence were actually verified. The trusted caller must verify those before construction.

testCases: unknown crm identifiers remain unresolved even when their string matches epharm()
same source cannot alias two canonical pharmacies()
source system entity and case form independent namespaces()
opaque ids are not trimmed or interpreted as numbers or UUIDs()
account person pharmacist and customer canonical identities never imply each other()
two crm branches cannot silently collapse to one canonical pharmacy()
existing epharm identifiers and types are retained exactly()
only an exact verified branch crosswalk resolves a crm branch()
repeated identical binding is idempotent and resolver snapshots its input()
blank ids and missing crosswalk provenance are rejected()
unsupported entity or source relationship cannot become a binding()
notProved: Actual532 bindings or148 unresolved rows were not loaded or recounted here.
No U4 schema/crosswalk persistence, legacy location-scope migration or account/person generation implemented.
No existing backend authentication/authorization behavior has been wired to this core.
